intent: A late-gothic marsh-court gown: a bone-V cuirass over a fen-green bodice and a narrow reed belt above a wide six-gored bell skirt lamed in reed straw all round and edged in bog iron, with a winged reed circlet, reading from the high camera as a narrow green top over a wide gold-striped bell.
reason: Valkyrie: the only set that reads as a gown at first sight, an ankle-length bell skirt of reed-straw and fen-green panels under a pale bone V cuirass and a winged reed circlet (second critic 6.7, first).
first_fix: The shoulders and sleeves are full blocks as wide as the hem: slim them to the arm and cinch the waist; soften the forked crest, which reads a little like horns.
